appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Theme, language and interface text size.

fontSize.label: Text size
fontSize.description: {{percent}}% of the default size — affects the whole interface.

layouts.title: Layouts
layouts.description: Choose which modes appear in the title-bar selector. With only one layout enabled the selector is hidden; at least one stays enabled.

behavior.title: Behavior
behavior.description: How the composer sends and displays messages.

sendWith.label: Send with
sendWith.description: Shift+Enter always inserts a new line.

reduceMotion.label: Reduce motion
reduceMotion.description: Disables transform animations, shimmer and long transitions.

showTokenUsage.label: Show token usage
showTokenUsage.description: Shows tokens and estimated cost under each response.

thinkingCollapsed.label: Reasoning collapsed by default
thinkingCollapsed.description: The reasoning and agent-step block starts closed and does not open by itself while streaming. You can expand it at any time.

keepInTray.label: Keep running in the system tray
keepInTray.description: Closing the window hides Zylara instead of quitting, so agent turns, routines and tasks keep running. Open it again or quit from the tray icon.
keepInTray.aria: Keep running in the system tray when the window is closed

appearance.title: Terminal appearance
appearance.description: Typography of the integrated terminal in the Code layout.

fontFamily.label: Font family
fontFamily.description: CSS font-family list. Leave empty to use the theme's monospace stack.

fontSize.label: Font size
fontSize.description: Character size of the integrated terminal.

trayPrompt.title: Keep Zylara running in the background?
trayPrompt.description: When you close the window, Zylara can stay in the system tray so background agent work keeps going. You can change this later in Settings → General.
trayPrompt.disable: Quit when I close the window

mode.title: Appearance
mode.description: Choose light, dark or follow the system. The theme supplies both palettes.
mode.label: Mode

library.title: Installed themes
library.description: Themes carry their own palette, radii, fonts and wallpaper. Install a .zip package with a theme.json manifest.

bundled.aurora: Cool teal and indigo over airy surfaces.
bundled.ember: Warm amber and terracotta with a paper-like feel.
bundled.grove: Sage greens and deep forest tones.
bundled.nebula: Purple and mint over deep cosmic surfaces.
bundled.nocturne: Violet, pink and mint on a nocturnal palette.

themes.empty: No custom themes yet. Install a .zip package to add one.
themes.loadFailed: Could not load the installed themes.

toasts.openFolderFailed: Could not open the themes folder

removeConfirm.title: Remove theme?
removeConfirm.body: Remove "{{name}}" from this computer? The package file on disk is not affected.

providers.securityNote: API keys (OpenCode/Anthropic/Google) and the ChatGPT session are stored only in the backend (secrets.json in app-data) and are never exposed to the interface. We also detect the providers' environment variables and an existing OpenCode CLI login.

connect.title: Connect {{name}}
connect.keyIntro: Enter your API key to connect your {{name}} account and use its models in Zylara.

more.title: See more providers
more.description: New providers show up here as soon as they are supported.

resilience.title: Reliability
resilience.description: Deadlines and automatic retries shared by every provider. Retries only happen before any text or tool call reaches the screen.

headers.label: Response headers timeout (s)
headers.description: Maximum wait between connecting and receiving the provider's response headers.

firstEvent.label: First token timeout (s)
firstEvent.description: Maximum wait for the first streamed event with model output.

idle.label: Stream idle timeout (s)
idle.description: Maximum gap between two events with output once the stream started.

total.label: Total stream timeout (s)
total.description: Absolute cap for one request; 0 disables the cap.

maxRetries.label: Retries per step
maxRetries.description: Extra attempts after the first request (0 disables automatic retries).

baseDelay.label: Base backoff (ms)
baseDelay.description: Starting delay of the exponential backoff with jitter.

maxDelay.label: Maximum backoff (ms)
maxDelay.description: Upper bound of a single retry delay.

maxElapsed.label: Retry budget (ms)
maxElapsed.description: Total wait allowed for retries of one step; 0 means unlimited.

afterCap.label: Maximum Retry-After (ms)
afterCap.description: Longest server-requested wait accepted; above it the error is shown with the requested wait.

providers.secretsErrorTitle: Could not read the secrets file
providers.secretsErrorBody: No key was changed. The original file was preserved; fix or delete the invalid content from the data folder before saving new credentials. Detail: {{error}}

keyPlaceholder.replace: Paste a new key to replace…
keyPlaceholder.gemini: Paste your Google AI Studio API key (AIza…)…
keyPlaceholder.opencode: Paste your OpenCode Console API key…

providers.testFailed: Failed to connect to the provider.

planNotice.title: You're using your ChatGPT plan
planNotice.body: Eligible requests consume the shared limit of your ChatGPT plan — the same pool used by ChatGPT and other apps. You can follow usage in ChatGPT at any time.

login.pendingBody: Finish signing in to ChatGPT. This window updates automatically when you return to Zylara.
login.browserNotOpenedTitle: The browser did not open automatically
login.browserNotOpenedBody: Copy the link and paste it into your browser. This window keeps waiting for the sign-in confirmation.
login.browserHint: If the browser does not open, use Copy link and paste the address into your browser.

planDisabled.title: ChatGPT plan usage is not activated
planDisabled.body: Your account is connected, but requests do not use the plan yet. Activate usage (consent) to keep using the models without per-token cost.

reauth.title: ChatGPT session expired
reauth.hintFallback: Sign in again to renew the credential. The account registration is reused.

signedOut.body: Eligible requests use your ChatGPT plan — the limit is shared across apps, Codex and ChatGPT Work. Without a plan, the same provider accepts a platform API key sk-….

accountDetails.tokensNote: Access and refresh tokens stay only in the backend and are never sent to the interface.

toasts.successPlan: Eligible requests use your ChatGPT plan.
toasts.successNoPlan: Plan usage is not activated for this account.
toasts.planDisabled: The account was connected, but plan usage is not activated. Use "Activate plan usage".
toasts.signOutBody: The tokens were revoked. The next connection reuses the same client registration.
toasts.copyFailedBody: Open "Show sign-in link" and copy the address manually.
toasts.keyStillDetectedBody: A key detected via {{source}} is still available.

providers.privacyFooter: Zylara does not send your credentials to any server of its own: requests go straight to the chosen provider. When you remove a key saved in Settings, detection via environment/CLI applies again, if present. Signing out of ChatGPT revokes the refresh token and keeps only the account registration for the next connection.

description.opencode-go: OpenCode subscription with monthly limits — no per-token billing.
description.opencode-zen: Pay-as-you-go catalog with curated models from several providers.
description.openai: ChatGPT plan sign-in or an OpenAI API key.
description.anthropic: Direct Claude access with an Anthropic API key.
description.gemini: Gemini models with a Google AI Studio API key.

opencode-go.0: Send the x-opencode-session header for better routing and prompt caching.
opencode-go.1: Models marked as "contributor" may use your data for training.

opencode-zen.1: Free models require the OpenCode client.

openai.0: Usage consumes your ChatGPT plan limit (the same pool shared by apps, Codex and ChatGPT Work).
openai.1: Plus accounts share the 5-hour window; Pro does not have that limit. App-specific limits may also apply.
openai.2: The model list is specific to the account: use "Refresh models" after signing in.

anthropic.0: Per-token billing on your Anthropic account (pay-as-you-go) — this provider does not use a subscription/plan.
anthropic.1: Create or review the API key at https://platform.claude.com/settings/keys.
anthropic.2: The account list is fetched from GET /v1/models; use "Refresh models" to merge new entries.
anthropic.3: API version pinned to anthropic-version: 2026-10-21 (no beta headers).

gemini.0: Per-token billing on your Google account (Gemini Developer API).
gemini.1: Create or review the API key at https://aistudio.google.com/apikey.
gemini.2: The account list is fetched from GET /v1beta/models and limited to Gemini 4 Carbon, Gemini 4 Argon and Gemini 3.8 Flash.
gemini.3: Thinking low/medium/high with summaries; long decode above 65,536 tokens is not supported.

model.title: Default model
model.description: Used in new conversations and as the composer's initial selection.
model.startedWarning: The current conversation has already started. The changes below apply only to upcoming conversations.

provider.label: Provider
provider.description: OpenCode Go (subscription), OpenCode Zen (credits) or OpenAI (ChatGPT plan or API key).

model.label: Model
model.description: Unavailable models are not listed here.

model.estimatedTitle: Model listed by your account: estimated capabilities.
model.reasoningNote: The reasoning default applies to the chosen model; models without support ignore this setting.
model.missingModel: The saved model ({{model}}) is not in the current catalog.
model.tipBody: You can also switch models from the selector at the top of the window or from the composer, without changing the default for upcoming conversations.

instructions.title: System instructions
instructions.description: A custom prompt attached to every conversation, on top of Zylara's default instructions.
instructions.placeholder:
E.g.: “Respond in English, concisely. Use tables when it makes sense and cite sources when using search.”

Leave blank to use only Zylara's default instructions (language, tools, generative UI format and safety).
instructions.footer: Custom instructions do not replace the internal safety rules, the generative UI format or the artifact policy — they only guide the tone and style of responses.

agent.title: Agent tools
agent.description: What the model can do during a response.

webSearch.label: Web search
webSearch.description: Lets the model search the internet and cite sources in the chat.

fileCreation.label: Create files
fileCreation.description: Lets the model generate artifacts (documents, spreadsheets, code, HTML).

attachments.label: Send attachments to the model
attachments.description: Includes extracted text and images from attachments in the context.

autoTitle.label: Generate automatic title
autoTitle.description: Creates a short conversation title on the first turn.

cache.title: Prompt cache
cache.description: How Zylara reuses the prompt prefix on providers that measure cache.

indicator.label: Show indicator
indicator.description: Shows the real-time cache hit in the Code context meter and in the Chat composer. Turning it off only hides the indicator: measurement continues.

anthropicTtl.label: Cache TTL (Anthropic)
anthropicTtl.description: How long the prefix stays cached on the Anthropic API. 1 h costs 2× on writes and reduces renewals mid-turn; 5 min costs 1.25×.

openaiRetention.label: Cache retention (OpenAI)
openaiRetention.description: How long OpenAI keeps the prefix in cache. Automatic lets the provider decide.

codeExecution.title: Code execution
codeExecution.description: Lets the agent run scripts to create documents, spreadsheets, presentations and images.

enable.label: Allow code execution
enable.description: Opt-in: the model only receives the execution tool when this is on.

codeExecution.warning: The code runs on this machine with your permissions and network access — it is not a system sandbox. The app's API keys are not passed through and every run has a time limit, but enable it only if you trust what the model will run.

timeout.label: Execution timeout
timeout.description_one: Each script is interrupted after {{count}} second.
timeout.description_other: Each script is interrupted after {{count}} seconds.

sandbox.title: Command sandbox
sandbox.description: Where the code agent's commands run. The default runs on this machine; Docker isolates the process with the workspace mounted at /workspace.

environment.label: Environment
environment.description: The panel's interactive terminal stays local; this option applies to the run_command/run_checks tools and agent jobs.

image.label: Docker image
image.description: It must exist in the local Docker (the app does not download images automatically). E.g. node:22-bookworm, python:3.12, ubuntu:24.04.

network.label: Network in the container
network.description: When off, the command runs with --network none. Turn it on only when the task needs to download dependencies or access the internet.
network.aria: Allow network in the Docker container

readOnlyRoot.label: Read-only rootfs
readOnlyRoot.description: The workspace at /workspace stays writable; the rest of the container is read-only.
readOnlyRoot.aria: Mount the container rootfs as read-only

sandbox.warning: Docker Desktop/Engine must be installed and running. The workspace is mounted at /workspace; the container can read and change those files, but has no access to the rest of the computer. Still, review what the agent runs.

codeSessions.title: Code sessions
codeSessions.description: Defaults for new sessions in the Code layout and how the workbench shows changes.

permission.label: Default permission mode
permission.description: Every new Code session starts in this mode. You can change it from the permission chip in the composer at any time — the change here applies to upcoming sessions.
permission.aria: Default permission mode for new Code sessions

diff.label: Open file diff
diff.description: Choose where a file's diff from the Changes tab opens when clicked.
diff.aria: Where to open the file diff

environment.title: Code environment
environment.description: Detected on this machine; nothing is installed automatically.

python.label: Python
python.description: Interpreter used by scripts that generate documents and spreadsheets.

node.label: Node.js
node.description: Interpreter used to run JavaScript scripts.

packages.title: Optional packages
packages.description: Expand the formats supported in Python scripts. The bundled helpers use only the standard library.
packages.installHint: To install the optional packages, run:

skills.title: Skills
skills.description: Instructions and scripts the agent can consult for specialized tasks.

panel.label: Skills panel in the sidebar
panel.description: Shows the Skills item in the sidebar. When off, management is still available here.
panel.aria: Show skills panel in the sidebar

skills.error: Could not load skills. Try checking the environment again.
skills.openFolderFailed: Could not open the skills folder

agents.intro: Model, instructions, workspace, permissions and capabilities are defined per agent in the persona editor. This tab only gathers the global preferences of the Agents layout.

queue.title: Execution and queue
queue.description: How many turns can run at the same time and each thread's queue size. Turns beyond the limit wait in their own conversation's queue.

global.label: Concurrent turns (global)
global.description: Up to {{count}} turns running at the same time across the app. The backend enforces this limit too.

perAgent.label: Concurrent turns per agent
perAgent.description: Prevents a single agent from taking every slot. Default: 1.

queueLength.label: Queued messages per thread
queueLength.description: When the queue reaches this size, new messages are refused with a warning.

budget.title: Budget
budget.description: Daily spending limit for agents. The backend refuses new turns once the limit is reached.

dailyLimit.label: Daily limit per agent (US$)
dailyLimit.description: Empty turns it off. The day's accumulated cost considers all of the agent's threads.
dailyLimit.aria: Daily cost limit per agent in dollars

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Alerts for background agent threads. The OS and the in-app toast respect these options.

enabled.label: Notifications enabled
enabled.description: When off, no background notification is emitted.

dnd.label: Do not disturb
dnd.description: Keeps alerts only in the Activity dialog, with no toast or OS notification.

browser.title: Controlled browser
browser.description: Host policy for the CDP browser. The denylist wins over the allowlist; cloud metadata is always blocked.

allowed.label: Allowed hosts
allowed.description: Comma-separated list (e.g. github.com, notion.so). Empty allows public hosts.

blocked.label: Blocked hosts
blocked.description: Always denied; evaluated before the allowlist.

privateHosts.label: Allow private hosts
privateHosts.description: Localhost, 127.0.0.1 and RFC1918 networks. Turn it off to avoid SSRF; required for local dev servers.
privateHosts.aria: Allow private hosts in the browser

routines.label: Browser in routines
routines.description: Allows browser actions in tasks/routines without an approval card. The host allowlist/denylist still applies; desktop stays fail-closed.

desktopApps.title: Desktop apps
desktopApps.description: Allowlist/denylist by process or window title, applied before any click/keypress. The denylist wins.

allowed.label: Allowed apps
allowed.description: Comma-separated (e.g. notepad, chrome, code). Empty allows all except the denylist.

blocked.label: Blocked apps
blocked.description: Always denied; evaluated before the allowlist.

computer.title: Private desktop (computer use)
computer.description: Desktop isolated in Docker, independent from the command sandbox. These options apply when the agent uses the “Private desktop” environment.

image.label: Computer use image
image.description: Graphical image published on GHCR (Xvfb + Chromium + xdotool + noVNC). Download it with the button or provide another image the daemon can reach. For production, prefer a fixed digest.

computer.daemonDown: The Docker Engine is not running, so the image could not be downloaded

container.label: Computer use container
container.description: Fixed name of the graphical container. It is created on the first screenshot and kept between actions.

actionsPerTurn.label: Actions per turn
actionsPerTurn.description: Computer use limit in a single turn.
actionsPerTurn.aria: Maximum computer use actions per turn

actionsPerHour.label: Actions per hour
actionsPerHour.description: Per-agent limit in a rolling one-hour window.
actionsPerHour.aria: Maximum computer use actions per hour

computer.warning: Docker Desktop/Engine must be installed and running. The agent controls an isolated display in the container; noVNC stays on loopback, only for you to watch.
computer.diagnosticsBody: {{turns}} active turn(s) · {{tasks}} open task(s) · {{sessions}} computer use session(s)

storage.title: Storage
storage.description: Everything stays on this machine only.

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.description: These actions are permanent and cannot be undone.
danger.clearDescription: Deletes conversations, messages, attachments, artifacts and saved API keys.
danger.confirmTitle: Are you sure you want to clear the data?
danger.confirmBody: Conversations, attachments, artifacts, settings and API keys will be deleted from this machine.
danger.finalBody: This is the last confirmation. Once deleted, conversations cannot be recovered.

toasts.clearedDescription: Settings were restored to their defaults.

about.title: About Zylara
about.description: Local-first desktop chat with OpenCode Go, Zen, OpenAI (ChatGPT) and Anthropic.

storage.label: Storage
storage.description: Local-first: nothing leaves your machine unless you send it.

links.title: Links
links.description: Opens in the default browser, never inside the app.

opencode.label: OpenCode
opencode.description: Official site of the Go and Zen providers.

console.label: OpenCode Console
console.description: Manage subscription, credits and API keys.

chatgpt.label: ChatGPT (OpenAI)
chatgpt.description: Sign in with your ChatGPT account and follow plan usage.

usage.label: ChatGPT plan usage
usage.description: Your plan's shared limits and consumption.

repository.label: Repository
repository.description: Source code, releases and project news.

about.footer: Zylara can make mistakes. Verify important information. API keys stay in the local backend and are never exposed to the interface.

update.title: Updates
update.description: Downloads and installs versions published on GitHub. The download is verified with SHA-256 and installation is always confirmed by you.

auto.label: Automatic updates
auto.description: Checks on startup and every hour while the app is open. Downloading and installing remain your decisions.

status.label: Status
status.upToDate: You are on the latest version

detail.idle: Zylara checks GitHub for stable releases. Nothing is installed without your confirmation.
